<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex02032025-04-2513-15-112" status="finalized"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">ma hA</rs> ltar na nyan thos dang rang rgyal gyi rtogs pa <abbr>thams cad</abbr> ni byang chub seMs dpa'i sa brgyad pa la skyed par byed pa yin pas de dag gi laM shes pa dang gzhi shes kyang sa de la gzhag par bya ba yin te <note type="gloss">°°°°°°</note> sa brgyad pa la rnaM par myi rtog pa'i <abbr>ye shes</abbr> la dbang thob <lb edRef="inst:4454" n="131b8"/> pa'i gzhi shes pa gzhan lugs su <note type="gloss">°°°°°°</note> gzugs <choice><orig>rnyan</orig><reg>brnyan</reg></choice> gyi tshul du bskyed pa'i phyir ro gsung ste | 
         <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3807">'bre</rs> na re</note> de ni mi rigs te gzugs brnyan gyi don gang yin | de rang rgyud pa'i rgyud la skye ba bzhin du dmyigs <choice><orig>bcan</orig><reg>pa can</reg></choice> <note type="editorial">"bcan" could also be read as "bcas"</note> du skye ba yin naM | 'on te mi dmyigs pa'i rnam pas de dag gi laM yon tan yar ldan du rgyud la skyed pa la bya | dang po ni ma yin te dmyigs <pb edRef="inst:4454" n="132a"/><lb edRef="inst:4454" n="132a1"/> pa ni sgro 'dogs pa yin pas | byang chub seMs dpa' de spangs pa yang de skyed par ji ltar 'gyur | gnyis pa yang ma yin te | mi dmyigs pa'i rnaM pa can de byang chub seMs dpa'i <note type="gloss">sa brgyad °°°</note> sa × <note type="gloss">sa °°° la sogs pa</note> 'og mar yang rgyud la skyed par mi nus pa ci yod | de ni gzugs <choice><orig>rnyan</orig><reg>brnyan</reg></choice> gyi don gzhi rkyang shes pa la zer ba yin skad do ||</seg></TEI>
